meta.title: Usage and cost dashboard
meta.description: Adds a usage and cost dashboard to DSH: how much you spent, where it went, and what is left. The full-page "usage dashboard" in the sidebar shows lifetime tokens, token and spending trends, model distribution with a per-model cost breakdown, an activity calendar, and the most expensive sessions. The "cost" tab at the top of a conversation breaks that one session down by model and by day, and the cost strip under the composer shows what the current session has spent so far. The sidebar row also keeps showing the current peak or off-peak window with a countdown. Every amount is an estimate from unit prices, not your real bill: 8 providers and 43 official price entries are built in and can be overridden per provider in Settings, and a model it cannot recognize is counted for usage only, never priced at another model's rate. Cash balance is read from DeepSeek official only; the other subscription quotas come from undocumented internal endpoints that may stop working, and a failure is reported for that provider alone. All data stays on this machine with no telemetry, disabling the plugin restores the original UI, and product theming is left untouched.
